theorem Tensor_elementwise_ops_preserve_validity (a b : Tensor)
    (hA : a.isValid) (hB : b.isValid) (hSize : a.data.size = b.data.size) :
    (∀ result, a.addElementwise b = some result → result.isValid) ∧
    (∀ result, a.subElementwise b = some result → result.isValid) ∧
    (∀ result, a.mulElementwise b = some result → result.isValid) ∧
    (∀ result, a.divElementwise b = some result → result.isValid) := by
  constructor
  · intro result hAdd
    unfold Tensor.addElementwise at hAdd
    rw [if_pos hSize] at hAdd
    cases hAdd with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      unfold Tensor.isValid
      rw [Array.size_zipWith]
      exact hA
  constructor
  · intro result hSub
    unfold Tensor.subElementwise at hSub
    rw [if_pos hSize] at hSub
    cases hSub with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      unfold Tensor.isValid
      rw [Array.size_zipWith]
      exact hA
  constructor
  · intro result hMul
    unfold Tensor.mulElementwise at hMul
    rw [if_pos hSize] at hMul
    cases hMul with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      unfold Tensor.isValid
      rw [Array.size_zipWith]
      exact hA
  · intro result hDiv
    unfold Tensor.divElementwise at hDiv
    rw [if_pos hSize] at hDiv
    cases hDiv with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      unfold Tensor.isValid
      rw [Array.size_zipWith]
      exact hA

theorem RSF_forward_inverse_consistency_spec (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor)
    (hInit : rsf.initialized = true) :
    ∀ y result, RSF.forwardPass rsf x = some y →
    RSF.inversePass rsf y = some result →
    result.shape = x.shape := by
  intro y result hForward hInverse
  match hX : x.shape.dims with
  | [batchSize, totalDim] =>
    have hYShape : y.shape.dims = [batchSize, rsf.dim * 2] := by
      unfold RSF.forwardPass at hForward
      rw [if_pos hInit] at hForward
      cases hX
      cases hForward with
      | some hY =>
        rw [hY]
        unfold Shape
        rfl
    have hResultShape : result.shape.dims = [batchSize, rsf.dim * 2] := by
      unfold RSF.inversePass at hInverse
      rw [if_pos hInit] at hInverse
      cases hYShape
      cases hInverse with
      | some hResult =>
        rw [hResult]
        unfold Shape
        rfl
    rw [hX]
    rw [hResultShape]
  | _ =>
    unfold RSF.forwardPass at hForward
    rw [if_pos hInit] at hForward
    cases hForward with
    | none =>
      contradiction

theorem Tensor_mean_bounds (t : Tensor) (hSize : t.data.size > 0) (hMin hMax : Float) (hAll : ∀ i, hMin ≤ t.data[i] ∧ t.data[i] ≤ hMax) :
    hMin ≤ t.mean ∧ t.mean ≤ hMax := by
  unfold Tensor.mean
  rw [if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hSize)]
  have hSumMin : t.data.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 ≥ Float.ofNat t.data.size * hMin := by
    induction t.data with
    | empty =>
      rfl
    | mk a as ih =>
      calc
        (a :: as.toList).foldl (· + ·) 0.0 = as.foldl (· + ·) a := rfl
        _ ≥ Float.ofNat as.size * hMin + hMin := add_le_add (ih) (hAll ⟨0, Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero as.size.ne_zero))⟩.1)
        _ = Float.ofNat (a :: as.toList).size * hMin := by
          rw [Float.ofNat_add]
          rw [Float.ofNat_one]
          rw [add_comm]
          rw [mul_add]
  have hSumMax : t.data.foldl (· + ·) 0.0 ≤ Float.ofNat t.data.size * hMax := by
    induction t.data with
    | empty =>
      rfl
    | mk a as ih =>
      calc
        (a :: as.toList).foldl (· + ·) 0.0 = as.foldl (· + ·) a := rfl
        _ ≤ Float.ofNat as.size * hMax + hMax := add_le_add (ih) (hAll ⟨0, Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero as.size.ne_zero))⟩.2)
        _ = Float.ofNat (a :: as.toList).size * hMax := by
          rw [Float.ofNat_add]
          rw [Float.ofNat_one]
          rw [add_comm]
          rw [mul_add]
  constructor
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_of_le (sum_nonneg' fun i => hAll i.1 |>.1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSumMin
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_of_le (sum_nonneg' fun i => hAll i.1 |>.1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSumMax

theorem Tensor_variance_nonneg (t : Tensor) (mean : Float) :
    t.variance mean ≥ 0 := by
  unfold Tensor.variance
  cases eq : t.data.size == 0
  · rw [if_pos eq]
    decide
  · rw [if_neg eq]
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply sum_nonneg'
      intro i
      mul_self_nonneg _
    · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _

theorem RSF_layerNorm_bounds (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    ∀ i, Float.abs result.data[i] ≤ Float.sqrt (Float.ofNat x.shape.dims.getD 1 0) := by
  intro result hNorm i
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  cases hNotNeg : eps ≤ 0
  · rw [if_pos hNotNeg] at hNorm
    cases hNorm
  · rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
    cases hShape : x.shape.dims
    · cases hNorm with
      | none =>
        contradiction
    · cases hNorm with
      | none =>
        contradiction
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      rw [Array.getElem_ofFn]
      have hStd : Float.sqrt (rowVar + eps) > 0 := Float.sqrt_pos.mpr (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (variance_nonneg _ _) hEps)
      have hDiff : origVal - rowMean ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        sorry
      have hDiffNeg : -(origVal - rowMean) ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        sorry
      have hAbsDiff : Float.abs (origVal - rowMean) ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        cases ge : origVal ≥ rowMean
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ge)]
          exact hDiff
        · rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg_of_lt (not_ge.mp ge))]
          exact hDiffNeg
      exact le_trans (abs_div_le_abs_div_right hAbsDiff hStd.le) (div_le_div_of_pos_left (Float.sqrt_nonneg _) hStd (le_refl _))

theorem RSF_layerNorm_preserves_shape (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) (batchSize featureSize : Nat)
    (hShape : x.shape.dims = [batchSize, featureSize]) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    result.shape = x.shape := by
  intro result hNorm
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  have hNotNeg : ¬(eps ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr hEps
  rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
  rw [hShape] at hNorm
  cases eq : featureSize == 0
  · rw [if_pos eq] at hNorm
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
  · rw [if_neg eq] at hNorm
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]

theorem RSF_layerNorm_preserves_size (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    result.data.size = x.data.size := by
  intro result hNorm
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  have hNotNeg : ¬(eps ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr hEps
  rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
  cases hShape : x.shape.dims
  · cases hNorm with
    | none =>
      contradiction
  · cases hNorm with
    | none =>
      contradiction
  cases hNorm with
  | some hRes =>
    rw [hRes]
    cases eq : featureSize == 0
    · rw [if_pos eq] at hNorm
      cases hNorm with
      | some hRes =>
        rw [hRes]
    · rw [if_neg eq] at hNorm
      cases hNorm with
      | some hRes =>
        rw [hRes]
        exact Array.size_ofFn _

theorem matmul_shape_preservation (a b : Tensor) (m k n : Nat)
    (hAShape : a.shape.dims = [m, k])
    (hBShape : b.shape.dims = [k, n]) :
    ∀ result, Tensor.matmul a b = some result →
    result.shape.dims = [m, n] := by
  intro result hMul
  unfold Tensor.matmul at hMul
  rw [hAShape] at hMul
  rw [hBShape] at hMul
  cases eq : k == k
  · rw [if_neg eq] at hMul
    cases hMul
  · rw [if_pos eq] at hMul
    cases hMul with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]

theorem RSF_zeroAllGradients_idempotent (rsf : RSF) :
    RSF.zeroAllGradients (RSF.zeroAllGradients rsf) = RSF.zeroAllGradients rsf := by
  unfold RSF.zeroAllGradients
  congr 1
  funext i
  unfold RSFLayer.zeroGradients
  cases (RSF.zeroAllGradients rsf).layers[i].initialized
  · rfl
  · unfold Tensor.zeroOut
    rw [Array.mkArray_mkArray]

theorem Tensor_copy_identity (t : Tensor) :
    Tensor.copy t = t := by
  unfold Tensor.copy
  rfl

theorem Tensor_isClose_symmetric (a b : Tensor) (rtol atol : Float) :
    a.data.size = b.data.size →
    Tensor.isClose a b rtol atol = Tensor.isClose b a rtol atol := by
  intro hSize
  unfold Tensor.isClose
  rw [if_pos hSize]
  unfold Tensor.isClose
  rw [if_pos (eq_comm.mp hSize)]
  have hComm : ∀ (x y : Float), if x > y then x - y else y - x = if y > x then y - x else x - x := by
    intro x y
    cases lt1 : x > y
    · rw [if_pos lt1]
      cases lt2 : y > x
      · contradiction
      · rw [if_neg lt2]
    · rw [if_neg lt1]
      cases lt2 : y > x
      · rw [if_pos lt2]
      · rw [if_neg lt2]
  congr 1
  funext pair
  rw [pair.swap_comm]
  cases pair with
  | mk x y =>
    rw [hComm]

        (a :: as.toList).foldl (· + ·) 0.0 = as.foldl (· + ·) a := rfl
        _ ≤ Float.ofNat as.size * hMax + hMax := add_le_add (ih) (hAll ⟨0, Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero as.size.ne_zero))⟩.2)
        _ = Float.ofNat (a :: as.toList).size * hMax := by
          rw [Float.ofNat_add]
          rw [Float.ofNat_one]
          rw [add_comm]
          rw [mul_add]
  constructor
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_of_le (sum_nonneg' fun i => hAll i.1 |>.1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSumMin
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_of_le (sum_nonneg' fun i => hAll i.1 |>.1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hSumMax

theorem Tensor_variance_nonneg (t : Tensor) (mean : Float) :
    t.variance mean ≥ 0 := by
  unfold Tensor.variance
  cases eq : t.data.size == 0
  · rw [if_pos eq]
    decide
  · rw [if_neg eq]
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply sum_nonneg'
      intro i
      mul_self_nonneg _
    · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _

theorem RSF_layerNorm_bounds (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    ∀ i, Float.abs result.data[i] ≤ Float.sqrt (Float.ofNat x.shape.dims.getD 1 0) := by
  intro result hNorm i
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  cases hNotNeg : eps ≤ 0
  · rw [if_pos hNotNeg] at hNorm
    cases hNorm
  · rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
    cases hShape : x.shape.dims
    · cases hNorm with
      | none =>
        contradiction
    · cases hNorm with
      | none =>
        contradiction
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
      rw [Array.getElem_ofFn]
      have hStd : Float.sqrt (rowVar + eps) > 0 := Float.sqrt_pos.mpr (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (variance_nonneg _ _) hEps)
      have hDiff : origVal - rowMean ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        sorry
      have hDiffNeg : -(origVal - rowMean) ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        sorry
      have hAbsDiff : Float.abs (origVal - rowMean) ≤ Float.sqrt (rowVar * Float.ofNat featureSize) := by
        cases ge : origVal ≥ rowMean
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ge)]
          exact hDiff
        · rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg_of_lt (not_ge.mp ge))]
          exact hDiffNeg
      exact le_trans (abs_div_le_abs_div_right hAbsDiff hStd.le) (div_le_div_of_pos_left (Float.sqrt_nonneg _) hStd (le_refl _))

theorem RSF_layerNorm_preserves_shape (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) (batchSize featureSize : Nat)
    (hShape : x.shape.dims = [batchSize, featureSize]) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    result.shape = x.shape := by
  intro result hNorm
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  have hNotNeg : ¬(eps ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr hEps
  rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
  rw [hShape] at hNorm
  cases eq : featureSize == 0
  · rw [if_pos eq] at hNorm
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]
  · rw [if_neg eq] at hNorm
    cases hNorm with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]

theorem RSF_layerNorm_preserves_size (x : Tensor) (eps : Float)
    (hEps : eps > 0) :
    ∀ result, RSF.layerNorm x eps = some result →
    result.data.size = x.data.size := by
  intro result hNorm
  unfold RSF.layerNorm at hNorm
  have hNotNeg : ¬(eps ≤ 0) := not_le.mpr hEps
  rw [if_neg hNotNeg] at hNorm
  cases hShape : x.shape.dims
  · cases hNorm with
    | none =>
      contradiction
  · cases hNorm with
    | none =>
      contradiction
  cases hNorm with
  | some hRes =>
    rw [hRes]
    cases eq : featureSize == 0
    · rw [if_pos eq] at hNorm
      cases hNorm with
      | some hRes =>
        rw [hRes]
    · rw [if_neg eq] at hNorm
      cases hNorm with
      | some hRes =>
        rw [hRes]
        exact Array.size_ofFn _

theorem matmul_shape_preservation (a b : Tensor) (m k n : Nat)
    (hAShape : a.shape.dims = [m, k])
    (hBShape : b.shape.dims = [k, n]) :
    ∀ result, Tensor.matmul a b = some result →
    result.shape.dims = [m, n] := by
  intro result hMul
  unfold Tensor.matmul at hMul
  rw [hAShape] at hMul
  rw [hBShape] at hMul
  cases eq : k == k
  · rw [if_neg eq] at hMul
    cases hMul
  · rw [if_pos eq] at hMul
    cases hMul with
    | some hRes =>
      rw [hRes]

theorem transpose2D_shape_swap (t : Tensor) (rows cols : Nat)
    (hShape : t.shape.dims = [rows, cols]) :

  rw [hShape] at hTrans
  cases hTrans with
  | some hRes =>

theorem createZeroTensor_valid (s : Shape) (hValid : s.isValid) :

theorem RSFLayer_zeroGradients_no_op_if_not_initialized (layer : RSFLayer)
    (h : layer.initialized = false) :

theorem RSF_zeroAllGradients_idempotent (rsf : RSF) :
    RSF.zeroAllGradients (RSF.zeroAllGradients rsf) = RSF.zeroAllGradients rsf := by
  unfold RSF.zeroAllGradients
  congr 1
  funext i
  unfold RSFLayer.zeroGradients

  · rfl
  · unfold Tensor.zeroOut
    rw [Array.mkArray_mkArray]

theorem Tensor_isClose_symmetric (a b : Tensor) (rtol atol : Float) :
    a.data.size = b.data.size →
    Tensor.isClose a b rtol atol = Tensor.isClose b a rtol atol := by
  intro hSize
  unfold Tensor.isClose
  rw [if_pos hSize]
  unfold Tensor.isClose
  rw [if_pos (eq_comm.mp hSize)]
  have hComm : ∀ (x y : Float), if x > y then x - y else y - x = if y > x then y - x else x - x := by
    intro x y
    cases lt1 : x > y
    · rw [if_pos lt1]
      cases lt2 : y > x
      · contradiction
      · rw [if_neg lt2]
    · rw [if_neg lt1]
      cases lt2 : y > x
      · rw [if_pos lt2]
      · rw [if_neg lt2]
  congr 1
  funext pair
  rw [pair.swap_comm]
  cases pair with
  | mk x y =>
    rw [hComm]

Amit mutatsz, az **részben** valós Lean-formalizáció (a kernel tényleg ellenőrzi), de ebben a formában nem teljes, „kész” formális verifikáció, mert vannak benne `sorry`-k (pl. az `RSF_layerNorm_bounds` bizonyításában). A `sorry` Leanben tudatos „lyuk”: lezárja a célt, de a tétel/lemma ilyenkor a `sorryAx` axiómára támaszkodik, tehát nem tekinthető teljesen bizonyítottnak.[1]

## Mitől „valós” egy Lean-bizonyítás?
Ha a fájl `sorry` nélkül fordul, és a tétel axiómafüggőségei nem tartalmaznak `sorryAx`-ot, akkor az adott állítás formálisan igazolt Leanben (a kernel által).  Ezt a gyakorlatban a `#print axioms <név>` paranccsal tudod ellenőrizni; ha a listában megjelenik a `sorryAx`, akkor valahol `sorry` (vagy ekvivalens „bevallott” bizonyítás) maradt.[2][1]

## A `rfl`/`unfold`-os részek mennyire „komolyak”?
Az olyan bizonyítások, hogy `unfold ...; rfl`, tipikusan definíciós (számoltatásos) egyenlőségeket igazolnak: a `rfl` akkor működik, ha a két oldal redukció után ugyanarra a kifejezésre egyszerűsödik (definíciós egyenlőség).  Ez teljesen „valódi” a Lean logikájában, csak gyakran azt jelenti, hogy a tétel tartalma inkább „a definíció így van megírva”, nem pedig mélyebb matematikai/algoritmikus helyesség.[3][4]

## Hogyan tedd „nem-placeholderré” (gyakorlatias checklista)
- Szedd ki az összes `sorry`-t, és ténylegesen bizonyítsd a hiányzó lemmákat; különben a végeredmény axiómával „bevallott”.[1]
- Futtasd: `#print axioms <tételnév>` és nézd meg, hogy nincs-e `sorryAx`.[2]
- Kapcsold be, hogy a warning ne csússzon át: `set_option warningAsError true` (így a `sorry`-hoz kapcsolódó figyelmeztetések hibává válnak, és megáll a build).[5]

## Rövid minősítés a konkrét snippetre
- A shape-korrektségi tételek jelentős része „definíció-követő” (unfold + rfl), ez formális, de inkább szerkezeti/„bookkeeping” jellegű garancia.[3]
- Mivel láthatóan maradt `sorry`, a csomag összhatásában ez jelenleg inkább egy formális váz (skeleton), nem lezárt, végig bizonyított verifikáció.[1]

Ha megírod, melyik tételnél akadtál el a `sorry` kiváltásában (pl. az `hDiff`/`hDiffNeg` rész), be tudom javasolni a tipikus Lean-lemma készletet és a bizonyítási stratégiát úgy, hogy tényleg eltűnjön a `sorryAx` a függőségek közül.[2]
